title: I'm Glad My Mom Died
author: Jennette McCurdy
summary: Former child actor Jennette McCurdy describes growing up under a controlling mother who pushed her into acting, shaped her eating habits, and whose death left her to work out who she was.
readIf: you want a frank, darkly funny memoir about family and the cost of childhood fame.
skipIf: you find accounts of eating disorders and parental abuse too distressing.
